macros.name: lastminidocument
macros.doc: The macro \lastminidocument unboxes the aggregated minidocument so that it can flow into the main document.

macros.name: minidocumentscale
macros.doc: By default, the minidocument is scaled down with \minidocumentscale, which defaults to 0.333.

macros.name: minidocumentshipout
macros.doc: The default \minidocumentshipout draws a frame around the page and scales the page with \minidocumentscale.

envs.name: minidocument
envs.doc: A minidocument is created with the minidocument environment. The page counter is set to one at the beginning of a minidocument and restored afterwards.
